raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms and ammunition under the EAR. Exporters of sporting shotguns, rifles, and related parts should re-verify ECCN/Commerce Control List classification, confirm whether items now fall under EAR99 or a lower-control ECCN, and update license determinations accordingly. US HTS alignment (Chapter 93), Section 301 tariff exposure, and BIS Entity List / restricted-party screening remain mandatory. Reassess end-user and end-use statements, and document the regulatory basis for any license exception used.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪械出口规则，放宽了民用枪械及弹药在《出口管理条例》（EAR）下的许可与分类处理。出口运动霰弹枪、步枪及相关零部件的企业应重新核实ECCN/商业管制清单分类，确认相关物项是否已归入EAR99或较低管制级别的ECCN，并相应更新许可判定。美国HTS编码对齐（第93章）、301条款关税风险以及BIS实体清单/受限方筛查仍为强制要求。需重新评估最终用户和最终用途声明，并记录所适用许可例外的法规依据。

checklist.desc: Re-verify ECCN or EAR99 status for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts following rescission of the Biden-era rule; update internal classification records.
Screen all consignees, end users, and intermediaries against BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List, and OFAC SDN before shipment.
Confirm 10-digit HTS classification for firearms and parts; document country of origin and value build-up for customs entry.
Map HTS lines against Section 301 lists and additional duties; quantify landed cost impact and retain supporting analysis.
Obtain and retain non-transferable end-user and end-use certificates; document the regulatory basis for any license exception claimed.
Verify compliance with applicable US environmental and safety requirements for ammunition components and lead content where relevant.
